details:
I have an overly insane idea. I see VRChat in the future to be a possible hub for other external game projects or virtual projects. Imagine if games could say “VRChat compatible” where you can have a special portal location in VRChat for compatible games, virtual websites, virtual esports tournaments, virtual libraries/ museums/ tourism..etc which could even allow you to transfer avatar data to an external project or virtual application. Taking it a step further, imagine if other external game companies or publishers had their own official VRChat world/ official public lobby before launching their games. I would imagine game publishers could make phenomenal worlds, add advertising and promotional stuff for other related content, and find greater opportunities to build immersion and maybe even launch their own official avatars or interactable objects from the games they publish. Personally I would like to see other external games that allow for the use of custom avatars found in VRchat to be played in their games. How crazy insane would that be? Therefore, I suggest by up-voting this idea, perhaps we can get the VRChat team to reach out to game publishers and game companies to create official content for VRChat and allow for the SDK to make VRChat content (avatars, VRChat controls, VRChat camera, player data, friends, and worlds) in-game compatible for launching in external games and external projects. As an example, I personally wouldn’t mind flying around Google Earth with my custom Miko avatar.
PS please don’t hate me for such an outrageous suggestion. lol
title: External Game Compatibility
